subject: Clarifying which audit package to accept for procurement review
messages:
From: Lisa Thomas <lisa.thomas@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Question on Redwood SOC 2 package for contract review

Hi Jordan —

We are finalizing the vendor security checklist for an upcoming procurement review. Your security packet that was uploaded to the portal includes two files: redwood_soc2_type2_2024.pdf (Type II) and bridge_attestation_q1_2026.pdf. The procurement team flagged that the Type II PDF covers an audit period that ends 2024-12-31 and they are unsure whether that satisfies our audit window (calendar 2025–2026).

Can you confirm: do you consider the bridge letter to be authoritative for continuous coverage through Q1 2026, or is there a more current reissued Type II report we should rely on? Procurement's deadline for an approval memo is 2026-09-20.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_2024.pdf (pdf), bridge_attestation_q1_2026.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Lisa Thomas
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Acme Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Thomas <lisa.thomas@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on Redwood SOC 2 package for contract review

Thanks for flagging this, Lisa — looping in Neha (security/compliance) and Marcus (account lead).

Quick answers up front: we consider the bridge attestation to cover the gap between the 2024 Type II and our next reissue, but we do not treat it as a full replacement of a reissued Type II in procurement-led control reviews. That said, we have historically allowed procurement teams to accept a signed bridge + evidence index for an initial PO while the auditor processes a formal reissue.

Neha — can you confirm whether the attached bridge has the signatures and auditor reference needed for Acme's procurement team, or if we should request a reissued Type II from our auditor right away? Procurement deadline is 09/20 — Lisa, if you can share any specific control owners or questions they raised I’ll escalate internally.

—Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Lisa Thomas <lisa.thomas@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on Redwood SOC 2 package for contract review

Jordan / Lisa — reviewing the two files provided. Summary below: 

- redwood_soc2_type2_2024.pdf — This is a full SOC 2 Type II report with testing period 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31. It contains the auditor opinion and control testing sections.
- bridge_attestation_q1_2026.pdf — This is an attestation signed by our ISO and countersigned by the same auditor firm stating that there have been no material changes to the control environment since 2024-12-31 through 2026-03-31. It is not a full Type II reissue; rather it is a limited-scope bridge intended for continuous coverage.

Implications for procurement: many buyers will accept the bridge if it is signed by the auditor and accompanied by an evidence index showing the controls sampled and relevant changes. If Acme requires auditor reissue (a full Type II covering a later period), that is a separate engagement and may take 4–6 weeks depending on auditor schedules.

Suggested path: 
- Short-term: accept bridge_attestation_q1_2026.pdf plus an evidence index (attached) and a short attestation from our compliance lead that no control changes impacting in-scope systems occurred after the bridge date. This typically satisfies procurement checklists that ask for continuity of coverage.
- Long-term: we will request a reissued Type II and share ETA; if Acme's vendor policy absolutely requires a reissued Type II for onboarding, we can accelerate the auditor engagement but need confirmation ASAP.

I've attached an evidence_index_20260914.csv summarizing the artifacts available for procurement review.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Thomas <lisa.thomas@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on Redwood SOC 2 package for contract review

Thanks, Neha — that is helpful. Procurement's formal policy prefers a reissued Type II but includes a discretionary pathway to accept an auditor-signed bridge + evidence index if legal and security agree. Our legal counsel asked whether the bridge includes the auditor firm registration number and signature block; the copy in the portal looks like a scanned PDF but the signature block is small.

If you can confirm the auditor's firm and provide either: (A) a higher-resolution signed bridge or (B) a short signed attestation from your compliance lead referencing the bridge and auditor firm, we can route this through the discretionary pathway and hit our 09/20 deadline. If not, we may need a reissued Type II and will have to delay the approval.

Procurement note: PO creation target is 2026-09-22.

Lisa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Thomas <lisa.thomas@acmehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on Redwood SOC 2 package for contract review

Lisa — we can do (A) and (B) immediately. Action items: 

1) Neha / Security to upload a high-resolution bridge PDF that includes the auditor firm name and registration, and attach a one-paragraph signed attestation referencing Acme's procurement requirement.
2) I will confirm acceptance path with Marcus and loop in Legal if they want specific language.

Temporary acceptance: Redwood is comfortable with procurement accepting the auditor-signed bridge + evidence index for PO issuance provided Acme's Legal signs off on the discretionary pathway. Jordan to confirm once Neha uploads documents.

Links: Shared Drive (high-res bridge + evidence index): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-soc2
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/CR-9982

—Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
